resources.string: A fight against a friend, each on their own phone.
Put the rooms server\'s address under Server, below.
%1$s is here: the game is starting…

One player creates a room and tells the other the code; the other joins with it. The game then starts on both phones: whoever created the room is player 1 and moves the menus, the other is player 2. Pick the two-player fight (Free Battle, 1P vs 2P) and fight.\n\nBoth phones need the same version of Hidden Leaf and the same mods switched on. The match uses a memory card of its own (your saves are not touched) and every character is open. The touch helpers (one-tap special, tap value) are off: both phones play by the game\'s own rules. Opening the game menu does not pause the match.
Each frame is 40 ms. Automatic picks it from the measured distance between the phones. The room creator\'s choice holds for both.
When the phones cannot reach each other directly (some mobile networks and routers), the match goes through the server. A little slower, but it plays.
The address of the Hidden Leaf Online Worker (https://…workers.dev). Both players need the same one.
Your Hidden Leaf is a different version from the server\'s. Update the app.
The room\'s game is not the same as yours: both need the same app version and the same mods switched on.
There is no room with this code (or it closed).
The room already has two players.
Server busy: try again in a moment.
Check the server\'s address (it starts with https://).
The server did not answer. Check the internet and the server\'s address.
%1$s\'s game did not start. Quit and create a new room.
The two games went apart: the match ended.
